details: Escalating US-Iran conflicts and Houthi attacks in the Red Sea have pushed Brent crude oil prices above $100, rekindling inflation fears and causing a broader market sell-off. Bitcoin fell below $65,000, and US Bitcoin Spot ETFs recorded $225.2 million in net outflows on July 23-24, breaking a seven-day positive streak. President Trump is reportedly considering a "massive attack" on Iran.
title: Geopolitical Tensions Escalate, Driving Bitcoin Outflows and Inflation Fears

details: The European Union has added cryptocurrency exchange HTX to its 21st sanctions package against Russia, banning all transactions between EU operators and HTX starting August 23. This move aims to prevent the circumvention of existing restrictions, targeting financial and crypto channels allegedly assisting Moscow.
title: EU Sanctions Crypto Exchange HTX Over Russia Links

details: The Trump administration has imposed new tariffs of 10% and 12.5% on goods from 60 trading partners, including the EU and China. These duties, enacted over alleged failures to address forced labor in supply chains, replace temporary tariffs and are expected to increase inflation risks, impacting global markets and cryptocurrencies.
title: US Imposes New Tariffs, Impacts Global Trade and Crypto

details: The Federal Reserve, Bank of England, and Bank of Japan are scheduled to announce their interest rate decisions next week. While markets largely anticipate a hold, there's a 35% probability of a 25 basis point rate hike by the Fed, especially after recent oil price surges renewed inflation concerns. These decisions will be closely watched for their impact on global liquidity and risk appetite in cryptocurrency markets.
title: Federal Reserve, Bank of England, and Bank of Japan to Announce Rate Decisions Next Week
